div.head: I As 4
div.ab: ⁊ ic wille eac, þæt mine gerefan gedon, þæt man agyfe þa ciricsceattas ⁊ þa sawlsceattas to þam stowum þe hit mid rihte togebyrige ⁊ sulhælmessan on geare, on þa gerad þæt þa his brucan æt þam haligan stowan, þe heora cyrcan begán willað ⁊ to Gode ⁊ to me geearnian willað. Se ðe þonne nelle, þolige þære are oððe eft to rihte gecyrre.

And I further desire that my reeves see to it that church dues and payments for the souls of the dead are rendered at the places to which they are legally due, and that 'plough-alms' [are rendered] yearly—on the understanding that all these payments shall be used at the holy places by those who are willing to attend to their churches, and wish to gain the favour of God and me. He who is not willing [to attend his church] shall either forfeit his benefice or revert to a proper discharge of his duties.

⁊ ic wille eac, þæt mine gerefan gedon, þæt man agife þa ciricsceattas ⁊ þa sawlsceattas to ðam stowum þe hit mid rihte togebirige ⁊ sulhælmessan on geare, on ða gerad þæt þa his brucan æt ðam haligum stowum, þe heora cirican began willað ⁊ to Gode ⁊ to me gééarnian willað. Se þe þonne nelle, þolige þare are oððe eft to rihte gecirre.
